market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at ~$2,265 on 4/30/26; YTD low ~$1,755 (Feb 2026). To hit $1,500 by Dec 31, 2026 requires -34% from spot, or -15% from Feb low. ETH historically very volatile and underperformed BTC. With 8 months remaining and bearish macro backdrop (yields surging, equity weakness risk), moderate probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether ETH-specific catalysts (ETF flows, scaling news) buoy price vs. macro selloff dragging it lower.
